checks.check: rule 2 -- each satellite is fed WHOLE by exactly ONE stage model
checks.detail: a satellite reading two sources is a satellite split across views, which is what rule 2 forbids and what this build is for

checks.check: rule 5 -- every hub is derived from the central views, via hub feeds
checks.detail: a hub fed from anywhere but the view its satellites are built on keys the hub from one place and its satellites from another

checks.check: rule 6 -- every link takes all its legs from ONE central view
checks.detail: legs taken from two views assert a relationship no row ever carried

checks.check: single hash site -- only the stage layer hashes a business key
checks.detail: a key hashed in two models has two spellings, and two spellings of one key are two keys

checks.check: no mapper notation survives into executable SQL
checks.detail: prose and notation are valid SQL once inside a function call, so only an explicit search finds them; the gates check form, not meaning

checks.check: every ref() resolves to a model this build emitted
checks.detail: a dangling ref is a model that cannot run, and dbt reports it only at run time

checks.check: model names are injective -- one logical object, one file, nothing overwritten
checks.detail: a name collision overwrites a file and leaves a layer one model short, which looks exactly like a layer that had one fewer object to emit

checks.check: no model in a feeding layer is orphaned
checks.detail: an orphan layer is dead code that looks like work; a sibling build shipped 104 dead stage models this way

checks.check: no model selects the same alias twice inside ONE select list
checks.detail: 30 models in a sibling build failed exactly this way, where a child-key leg collided with a payload attribute of the same name. Population is select LISTS, not models, because that is the unit the defect lives in

checks.check: every FULL OUTER join keys on the coalesce over all already-joined tables
checks.detail: keying on the first table alone scatters one business key across several partial rows, which no structural check and no gate can see

the gate discovers satellites by globbing models/automate_dv/*/satellites/*.sql, a gen-1 path. This project emits them under models/vault/satellites/, so the gate found 0 of them and every finding downstream of that discovery -- its 0% coverage and its 554 'satellite not built at all' items -- is an artifact of looking in the wrong place, not a result. Its two findings that do NOT depend on that discovery were checked by hand and are both false positives: the 109 'illegal alias' items are comment text (' ... reads as work.'), and the 764 'alias selected more than once' items are the cast keyword in cast(col as varchar). Check 9 here re-measures the real figure as 0. The gate is NOT edited, because vault_tools is shared by every project in this estate.
